payload.subject: We Value Your Business - Let's Enhance Your Experience
payload.body:
Dear Customer,

We noticed your recent activity and want to ensure you are getting the most out of our service. We are committed to improving your satisfaction and would love to hear any feedback you may have.

Additionally, we would like to offer assistance to help you increase your usage and engagement with our platform, which can enhance the value you receive.

Please feel free to reach out to our support team for any help or questions.

Thank you for being a valued customer.

Best regards,
Customer Success Team

payload.summary: Customer shows high churn risk with low CSAT score and low engagement
payload.reason: Customer has a high churn probability (25.51%) with low CSAT score (1) and moderate usage metrics. Needs proactive engagement and support to improve satisfaction and retention.
action_steps: Reach out to customer to understand dissatisfaction and usage barriers
Offer personalized support and training to increase feature usage and engagement
Monitor customer satisfaction and usage metrics closely
Consider contract upgrade incentives to increase commitment

payload.summary: Low CSAT and high churn risk for Enterprise customer with monthly contract

payload.subject: Enhance Your Experience with Our Quarterly Plan and Features
payload.body:
Dear Customer,

We value your partnership and want to ensure you get the best from our service. We noticed you might benefit from upgrading your contract to our Quarterly plan, which offers enhanced value and commitment benefits.

Additionally, we encourage you to explore more features and engage more frequently to maximize your experience.

Our team is here to support you and address any concerns you may have. Please feel free to reach out.

Best regards,
Customer Success Team
